question.problem:
$$
P=[\begin{aligned}0.2 & 0.5 \\ 0.8 & 0.5\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}0.7 \\ 0.3\end{aligned}]
$$

 

Consider a Markov chain with the stochastic matrix $P$ and the initial state vector ${x}_{0}$ given above. Calculate the state vector ${x}_{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the state vector ${x}_{2},$ we apply two steps of the Markov chain:

$$
{x}_{1}=P{x}_{0},\,{x}_{2}=P{x}_{1}
$$

After the first step, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =P{x}_{0} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.2 & 0.5 \\ 0.8 & 0.5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.7 \\ 0.3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.29 \\ 0.71\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, after the second step, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & =P{x}_{1} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.2 & 0.5 \\ 0.8 & 0.5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.29 \\ 0.71\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.413 \\ 0.587\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
